scope: Pinned Cranelift select instruction's ScalarTruthy condition, true/false operands, interpreter Opcode::Select choice, and DataValue::I8 nonzero truth conversion agree with the separately supplied local VeriISLE i64 select model.

evidence.independent_definition_source: Pinned Cranelift interpreter and instruction metadata, not the provisional VeriISLE spec itself

relationship_to_previous: Strengthens but does not replace conditional named VeriISLE check #41572121953 (one applicable rule expansion passed under the provisional model); separately recorded pure QF_BV proof, finite native tests, and size A/B remain unchanged.
limitations: Source-backed semantic agreement is not equivalent to accepted upstream VeriISLE semantics or a full independent compiler proof.
Defined scalar i8 conditions and i64 branch values only; no vector, poison, undefined, traps, flags, ABI or machine-target modeling.
No broader compiler-opt rule chaining, cross-target cost, runtime acceleration, or upstream adoption qualified.
No changes to Wasmtime upstream, ZenoFCIS main or the release/2.7.0 branch.
